description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing and automating interactions with a Perforce (p4) version control system and Git. It includes test cases for preserving user information during p4 submissions, managing permissions, and handling author mappings between Git and p4.

methods.name: p4_grant_admin
methods.description: Grants admin privileges to a specified user in p4 by modifying protections.

methods.name: p4_check_commit_author
methods.description: Checks whether the latest change to a file in p4 was made by a specific user.

methods.name: make_change_by_user
methods.description: Creates a change in a file with specified author details, commits it to Git, and optionally affects p4.
